text.tspan: Very suspicious. Main takeaway I had with Rosii vlog was he
brought his suit to Cinna room to change instead of changing in
his room. EE was not live streaming so why couldn't he change in
his own room other than he didn't want to change around EE off
camera. So why did EE flim in that room. Either someone was in her
room or she bought the same shit room Nat bought.
